senses.gloss:
ऋजु ऋज्-उ, adj.
 1. Straight, Man. 2, 47.
 2. Right, Rām. 4, 34, 31.
 --Comparat. ऋजीयंस्, and ved. also रजीयंस्; superl. ऋजिष्ठ, and ved. also रजिष्ठ.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ὄργυια, f. of ὀργυ, properly the measure of a tall upright man, i. e. six feet in general.

ऋजुता ऋजु + ता, f.
 1. Straightness, Kumāras. 4, 23.
 2. Plainness, Amar. 67.
